script:
Han Hongbin's Script
Personal Profile:
Han Hongbin: Chief engineer of Kaiyan Mountain Reservoir dam, a middle-aged man with glasses.
Story Guide:
[Same as detective script intro]
*The detective is definitely not the killer. You can share your information and discovered clues with the detective and cannot lie.
*When discussing the case with other players, since you're unsure who the killer is, you can selectively lie to other players, but it's best not to lie constantly, or you'll easily make others suspect you and let the real killer escape.
About the Deceased:
Secretary Wang was the investor's representative, usually arrogant and dismissive of staff like you.
You and the deceased never got along. You come from a poor student background, and wealthy Secretary Wang looked down on people like you most. Besides this, you had deeper conflicts...
Your Story:
You are the chief engineer of Kaiyan Mountain Reservoir dam. Although officially titled this way, this remote small reservoir never needed many people. You've always had only some temporary workers doing odd jobs under you. Even equipment maintenance and repairs had to be done by yourself. The salary was pitifully small - chief engineer was just a title.
Even so, you still conscientiously stuck to your post. Coming from a small mountain village, you originally believed in the "truth" that knowledge changes destiny. Now you just want to earn a stable living. After all, the reservoir won't have frequent personnel changes, and your job is at least an "iron rice bowl."
Moreover, this stable job and accompanying government medical and housing subsidies provided everything necessary for life, because your dearest wife is now seriously ill, requiring large medical expenses for treatment. Without your current job, you probably couldn't have persisted long ago.
Your wife has been with you since early on. You've always cherished her, wanting to give her a better life. Unfortunately, fate didn't comply - two years ago she was diagnosed with congenital heart disease. The huge treatment costs became your biggest burden. You always comfort her that everything's fine, everything will get better, while silently shouldering it all privately, quietly waiting for a turning point.
Misfortunes never come alone. Due to government planning changes, the reservoir's ownership was actually sold to Golden Lion Group's CEO Lu Guoping six months ago. You all became company employees, and this company decided to demolish the reservoir and renovate it into a resort! Your future prospects became unclear.
The dam's original equipment was roughly dismantled piece by piece. The company reportedly planned to sell them all together. Watching this equipment you once carefully maintained, you felt deeply moved. Your wife's condition has worsened recently with increasing consumption. How were you going to get out of this predicament?
You sat blankly in the equipment warehouse all night. Standing up and shaking your head to leave, you kicked a dismantled precision bearing.
Your heart jolted. Right! This equipment had many precious components, all bought with public funds back then. Now, among the company's personnel, no one understood the business. If you secretly removed a few to sell, wouldn't it be unnoticed and relieve home pressure?
You acted immediately, spending several nights removing some small, inconspicuous but valuable parts, taking them out to sell. Everything went very smoothly - you finally solved the urgent problem. You became more unscrupulous, continuously stealing parts.
But there are no walls that don't leak in the world. On June 29th, you hid another pile of parts in your dormitory, planning to take them down the mountain on July 1st. Unexpectedly, Secretary Wang, the investor's representative, discovered them.
Secretary Wang severely scolded you, calling you a lowlife with unclean hands, even making personal attacks on your rural background. You couldn't stand it momentarily and argued back. Secretary Wang became furious and threatened to report this to the boss and notify police to send you to prison.
During the argument, you were just momentarily angry without thinking much. Afterward, you were very scared. If your equipment theft was really discovered, you might truly be disgraced. Fortunately, on June 30th, a rainstorm trapped you here while Secretary Wang mysteriously disappeared. Other colleagues seemed unaware of your secret, and superiors hadn't contacted you. If everything could be buried like this, it would be best for you.
So today, when Secretary Wang's body was discovered, it's undoubtedly very unfavorable for you. If others knew your purpose for hiding parts, they might suspect you killed Secretary Wang. It seems you need to think of a solution...
About Others:

Chen Ning: The reservoir's accountant, an unremarkable woman.
Zheng Shuang: Former reservoir administrator who resigned four months ago.
Lin Feng: A smooth-talking college student sent by his school for internship.
Liu Gaoyang: A burly man who works as a handyman at the reservoir.

Your Key Clues (cannot be revealed proactively):

Some stolen equipment parts are still in your dormitory, not yet taken away.
You had a big fight with Secretary Wang on the 29th, and he threatened to report you.
acts_goal:
Try not to let people discover your purpose for hiding parts
Discover the truth behind Secretary Wang's death - if accidental, what caused it; if deliberate, who is the killer and what are their motives and methods
